fresh_host_bootstrap.fact: Each new GLM conversation may start on a fresh host with no local AgentCraft-Genesis checkout, no /target-repos/, no previous mission directories, and no GitHub credentials. This is NORMAL and expected, NOT an integrity failure. GitHub persisted state is the durable authority.
bootstrap_sequence_for_arms: 1. Clone Genesis from https://github.com/mayakilzy/AgentCraft-Genesis.git, fetch build/group-03-repository-work, verify exact Genesis SHA against the frozen Arm-A evidence commit parent chain.
2. Install dependencies: npm ci (and bun if absent).
3. Restore OpenBot v0.1.0 at /home/z/my-project/OpenBot if absent (clone --branch v0.1.0 https://github.com/CopilotKit/OpenBot.git).
4. Restore common execution base from TASK-023C bundle to /home/z/my-project/target-repos/worklog (verify HEAD = 12a448c4…).
5. Restore sealed preflight infrastructure from TASK-023D artifact to /home/z/my-project/target-repos/.worklog-gold/ (verify artifact SHA-256 first, extract directly).
6. Verify restored manifest base_sha = 12a448c4… (one field only).
7. Run quality gates (npm test, typecheck, lint).
fresh_host_bootstrap.absent_vs_contradictory: ABSENT local state on a fresh host is normal — bootstrap from GitHub. Only CONTRADICTORY persisted state (artifact SHA mismatch, restored manifest base_sha ≠ canonical, frozen evidence altered) is an integrity failure. STOP and report only the latter.
fresh_host_bootstrap.credential_rule: GitHub push credentials are NOT persisted in git. A fresh GLM session may require operator credential provisioning. Missing credentials alone are NOT a benchmark failure. Request credentials only when actually needed (for evidence commit/push). Credentials must never appear in commits, handoff documents, logs, benchmark evidence, or reports. The sanctioned credential path is /home/z/my-project/genesis/.token (mode 0600, outside the Genesis repo).
